description.text:
The last e-Card set and the last set from Wizards of the Coast, released on 12 May 2003 with 182 cards: 144 in the main numbering, 32 holos numbered H1 to H32, and six Crystal Pokémon beyond the numbering, Celebi, Charizard, Crobat, Golem, Ho-Oh and Kabutops, found in holo and reverse holo. It combined two Japanese sets, Split Earth and Mysterious Mountains, its theme decks were Eeveelution and Mind Machine, and its Buried Fossil is printed as a Pokémon that evolves into Omanyte, Kabuto or Aerodactyl.

By 2003 the first wave of Pokémon fever had passed, and Skyridge is counted among the least printed sets; its boosters were hard to find. Pokémon USA took the English cards over from Wizards, starting with EX Ruby & Sapphire that June. Skyridge's Kadabra was also the last for twenty years: after Uri Geller sued over the Pokémon, none was printed until 151.
